name: map-block-gutenberg

gmw-map-block-key.note: The plugin's editor default API key belongs to each environment; absence also remains environment-owned.

notes: Official 1.35 assets/js/_source/blocks/index.js buildMapIframe() saves the API key in iframe.src even when Gutenberg omits the default api_key attribute. An attribute-presence refusal is insufficient. The whole-block interpreter refuses every webfactory/map, including empty/default and nested blocks, before capture or materialization; its repository constraint also refuses hand-authored map blocks during immutable compilation without WordPress.

Production transport requires one reviewed environment-binding primitive spanning the block attributes and saved iframe HTML, with target editor save/validation and recapture evidence. This capsule does not implement that primitive or claim map-content transport. Only the exact audited 1.35 release is exercised.
